channel.title: BBC Live Lessons
channel.desc: Travel back in time to a world of giants in this dinosaur-themed Live Lesson. Help presenters Maddie Moate and Cam Whitnall, along with an enthusiastic group of young dinosaur detectives, solve a prehistoric mystery inspired by Walking with Dinosaurs, the series that brings earth?s most extraordinary creatures roaring back to life. Under the expert guidance of palaeontologist Dr Nizar Ibrahim, children will learn to think and work like true fossil scientists. As they uncover clues, they will explore how fossils form, what they reveal about ancient habitats, and how adaptations help animals survive and thrive. Filmed at the Lapworth Museum of Geology in Birmingham, this Live Lesson transforms the classroom into a dinosaur dig site. Bringing together science, hands-on discovery, and the awe and wonder of Walking with Dinosaurs, this is one lesson that might just inspire the next generation of fossil hunters and scientists.
